title: Special Topics in Accounting; AI-Driven Accounting Analytics and Automation
description:
Prerequisites: BMGT220 and BMGT301, or the equivalent. Restricted to Accounting Majors

In response to the growing demand for analytics and automation skills in accounting, this course equips students with essential tools for modern financial analysis. The course focuses on Python and Alteryx, teaching students to analyze financial data, automate workflows, and visualize insights efficiently. AI tools will assist students in coding, debugging, workflow design, and data manipulation, helping them learn faster and work more effectively. By the end of the course, students will have hands-on experience applying Python and Alteryx to real-world accountingchallenges, gaining practical skills and confidence to excel in a data-driven accounting profession.
